description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the CandidateDao component within the Recruitment plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It contains setup routines and multiple test methods verifying CRUD operations, data retrieval with filters, and logging of candidate-related actions.

classes.name: CandidateDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class designed to verify the functionality of CandidateDao methods including creating, retrieving, deleting, and filtering candidates and related entities within the recruitment process.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the CandidateDao instance and populates test data fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testSaveCandidate
methods.description: Tests saving a new candidate and verifies the returned object and its properties.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Tests saving a candidate vacancy relation and verifies the associated entities.

methods.name: testGetCandidateById
methods.description: Tests retrieving candidates by ID, including a case where the candidate does not exist.

methods.name: testGetCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Tests retrieving candidate vacancy details by candidate ID.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidates
methods.description: Tests deleting candidates by IDs and confirming their removal.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Tests removal of candidate vacancy entries.

methods.name: testGetCandidateList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of candidate lists without filters.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByCandidateId
methods.description: Filters candidate list by candidate ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByVacancyId
methods.description: Filters candidate list by vacancy ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByJobTitleId
methods.description: Filters candidate list by job title ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByHiringMangerId
methods.description: Filters candidate list by hiring manager ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByStatus
methods.description: Filters candidate list by application status.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByMethodOfApplication
methods.description: Filters candidate list by method of application.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Tests saving a candidate history record and verifies its properties.
